fix(cpu): SIM-BUG-10..15 — ALU, M1 decode, JAL, JR, and halt fixes

Fix 6 simulator bugs found during hardware alignment:
- SAR: arithmetic right shift instead of unsigned division (SIM-BUG-10)
- SLT/SGT: signed comparison with correct operand order (SIM-BUG-11)
- M1: decode sub-function from bits[11:8] not bits[3:0] (SIM-BUG-12)
- HALT: pipeline drain + 2-addr oscillation detection (SIM-BUG-13)
- JAL: exempt regPC from rega==0 suppression (SIM-BUG-14)
- JR: use forwarded register value for jump dest (SIM-BUG-15)
